masks: remove 3 of 7 scalars at each valid action position; preserve original reduction; uniform random channel subset per position in random arm
norm_matching: measure actual masked-arm weight delta L2 at every matched step; full-loss AdamW proposal followed by scalar rescaling and independently seeded stochastic BF16 rounding; retain AdamW moments from full supervision and log realized error
native_held_out: first 20 new sampled physical states qualifying with locked Front12000 prefix and no K18-D predictions
front_fit: ten independent validation demonstrations, all four channels and all geometric phases, matching action indices
decision: source-specific evidence requires old Right routing advantage over both controls across seeds, alongside comparable Front quality; report observed trade-off if any; ten percentage points Front terminal drop is a descriptive screening threshold, not an equivalence proof
parameter_readout: project each branch actual cross-attention K/V delta since its own step 30 onto historical step 30->100 delta
